subject: KiteCloud pricing: reconciled quote, bundling options, and migration economics
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@kitecloud.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RFP: inference platform pricing and migration options

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking our initial call last week. Attached is the updated RFP (v3) with the usage profile, retention constraints, and our current supplier economics. High level ask: can Redwood provide a price-reconciled proposal that shows (a) a matched per-token and embedding line-item vs our incumbent, (b) an explicit migration credit or onboarding concession, and (c) optional bundling (observability + dedicated capacity) pricing so we can evaluate TCO and go/no-go timelines.

Key constraints:
- Procurement needs a 12-month commercial comparison and an upfront credit option in writing.
- Security requires SOC2 evidence (we have that in the RFP attachments).
- Timeline: procurement decision targeted week of 4/19.

Attaching the RFP and the incumbent bill summary for visibility. Let me know if you want a short working session with our SRE and procurement next week.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Cloud Procurement, KiteCloud

[Attachment: incumbent_bill_summary.xlsx (12 KB)]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@kitecloud.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 13:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: inference platform pricing and migration options

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the RFP and the bill summary. Quick read-through notes below and a few asks so we can produce a reconciled quote in time for your procurement window:

1) We can match token/embedding economics on the baseline usage band you sent, but need to align on sequence-length distribution and KV cache hit rates to firm the per-token number (those materially change unit cost). Can your SRE share a short sample (2–3 representative traces) next week?

2) Migration concession: we typically structure a two-part concession for swaps — an onboarding credit to offset initial integration effort, plus a time-bound usage credit that phases down over 3 months. I can draft two options (lean credit vs. full migration stipend) for internal review.

3) Bundling: observability + dedicated capacity gets a step discount due to predictable consumption. I’ll include a packaged SKU with optional add-ons (longer retention for traces, extended SLA).

4) Security/compliance: SOC2 report and our standard encryption/KMS note attached for procurement checklist.

Propose a 30-minute working session Thurs 4/8 or Mon 4/12 with your SRE and procurement to resolve the trace samples and finalize the concession structure. I copied Laura (pricing lead) so she can help model the scenarios.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (150 KB)]
From: procurement@kitecloud.com

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFP: inference platform pricing and migration options

Markus / Laura —

Thanks. A few specific procurement items to include in the formal quote:
- A line itemized comparison table against our incumbent (we will provide the incumbent unit rates per the attached spreadsheet).
- Two concession scenarios: (A) one-time onboarding credit (USD) + (B) blended monthly credit over Q1 post-go-live. Please show net-new spend over 12 months in each scenario.
- An explicit SLA uplift option tied to a quarterly credit if latency SLOs are missed during onboarding.
- Pricing for a 12-month committed tier with true-up vs pay-as-you-go.

Separately, our legal wants non-standard termination language removed; we can share the redlines once we see the commercial baseline.

We are available Thurs 4/8 11:00–11:30 PT for a working session with SRE. CC'd Connor from our integration team to validate runtime assumptions.

procurement@kitecloud.com
[Attachment: incumbent_line_items.csv (8 KB)]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: inference platform pricing and migration options

Laura / Connor —

Forwarding KiteCloud's procurement reply and attachments. Ask: can you each run a quick sensitivity for these two scenarios?

- Scenario A (minimal): match incumbent per-token + one-time onboarding credit of USD 50k; show net-new spend and month-by-month cashflow for 12 months.
- Scenario B (aggresive credit): match incumbent per-token + onboarding credit USD 150k + 3-month phased usage credit equal to 30% of baseline monthly spend.

Key technical assumptions that procurement flagged: KV cache hit-rate (assume 45% vs their current 30% in baseline), average sequence length (they report median 128 tokens but 95th 512). If those numbers are off we should show alternate rows.

Also include an optional packaged SKU: Dedicated medium pool + 30-day observability retention + enterprise tracing at a $/month price and show how that packages against the committed discount. I'm booking Thurs 4/8 11:00 PT for the short call — please bring a one-slide cost bridge we can present.

Thanks,
Markus

Olivia / KiteCloud procurement —

Thanks for the clarity and the incumbent line items. Per our internal modeling (attached term sheet + pricing worksheet) we can present two reconciled offers for your review in the working session:

Offer 1 — Competitive-match (conservative):
- Per-token and per-embedding lines matched to the incumbent for the baseline usage band provided.
- One-time onboarding credit: USD 50,000.
- 12-month committed tier at a 7% blended discount vs pay-as-you-go.
- Optional SLA uplift (monthly credit if onboarding latency > target) priced separately.

Offer 2 — Momentum swap (aggressive):
- Per-token matched + a time-bound usage credit for the first 3 months equal to 30% of baseline monthly spend.
- One-time onboarding credit: USD 150,000.
- Packaged SKU: Dedicated medium pool + Redwood Observability (30 days retention) at a 12% discount vs separate purchase.
- 12-month committed tier with true-up terms and a 90-day rollback window.

Attachments: I included a term sheet (Redwood_TermSheet_KITE-2027-042.docx) and a simple cost-bridge slide. In the call we will: (a) validate the KV cache and sequence assumptions, (b) walk the 12-month cashflow for each offer, and (c) capture your legal redlines to align termination language.

Meeting: Thurs 4/8 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Please confirm SRE trace sample prior to the call — that will let us finalize the per-token match with confidence.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
